notes.title: Void Eclipse has released!
notes.content:
Void Eclipse has now released on Steam!

We're very excited to see everyone play and try out our little game. From our Kickstarter campaign concept, to Beta our game has grown with the help of players and backers.

This marks our 1.0 release, but we have plans moving forward to add additional modes and content and shape the balance and gameplay even further with player feedback.

We hope you enjoy our game, and this new sci-fi mashup of cards, tactics, and turn-based strategy!

As always, pop into our discord to chat and give your feedback and gameplay thoughts!
discord.gg/voideclipse

If you've enjoyed the game, a review is super helpful, especially for a small team like Tau Ceti Studios. Thanks for supporting an Indie developer and a new type of game!

notes.title: Prologue: New Mission
notes.content:
This major patch includes the latest Mission4 using the latest AI (AI scouts for resources, creates attack fleets, uses skills) and overhauls to the fleet animation, camera, and selection.

Total disk size was reduced and the planet models updated!

Beta Testers welcome! Check out our Discord for more info.

New Features

[olist]
 Mission4 the final mission of the Prologue is available for players to test their wits against the Varegon Empire that will explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate!

 AI uses specialized skills available to the player (anti-infantry, rush, focus, etc.)
 A Global Fleets button was added to the mission UI to allow players to view and select ALL of their fleets. Shows fleet name, fuel remaining, location.
 Fleet camera and selection was updated with feedback from beta testers and Next Fest demo players
 Fleet animation speed was increased, and can now be fine-tuned in the Options->Gameplay menu!
 Performance and size of battle environment was optimized.
 Planet 3D model textures/materials overhauled for all non-gas giant planets (look more like planets instead of marbles)
 The game's total size on Disk was drastically reduced down below 6GB.
[/olist] 

Known Issues

These will be fixed in future patches
[olist]
 Enemy commander avatars are shown on screen before they are mentioned in the storyline.
[/olist]

notes.title: Beta v0.037 Release
notes.content:
The unit abilities are finally getting some attention. Three units have their abilities included, and the radial menu for using them has been improved.

The Glossary/MemoryFragment UI has been added for more story lore and the Personality Matrix UI for upgrading your commander is now in the game. 
Both can be viewed by selecting the little robot skull in the upper left of the Mission selection screen or while in a mission.

Beta Testers please report bugs and feedback via Discord. If you don't want to use Discord you can email via the Bug Reporting link.

New Features

 Memory Fragment + Glossary UI added
 Reputation UI overhaul + Personality Matrix ability UI
 Camera Shake for explosions/impacts
 Unit Attack and Active Ability video preview clips for Initiate, Spy, and Nanoswarm
 All abilities for Initiate/Spy/Nanoswarm implemented
 Active Ability radial menu control overhaul
 Project updated to Unreal Engine 4.25 to utilize the latest Niagara VFX tools

Bug Fixes

 Main Menu buttons invisible no-click/hover zones have been removed.

Known Issues
These will be fixed in future patches

 Enemy commander avatars are shown on screen before they are mentioned in the storyline.
 Fleets in the Search&Destroy mission sometimes move very slowly.

notes.title: Beta v0.036 Release
notes.content:
This beta patch introduces 2 new tutorial missions, and opens up player freedom quite a bit.

Beta Testers please report bugs and feedback via Discord. If you don't want to use Discord you can email via the Bug Reporting link.

New Features

 Semi-random Events! Some planets will surprise players with an Event, where they'll be able to make tricky choices as commander.
 Full size maps provide the backdrop for learning how to explore with multiple fleets and earn resources.
 Difficulty setting in Options->Gameplay menu. Acolyte is the default. (Would love feedback on these!)
 The Scout and Acolyte units are unlocked and playable in these missions. Scout missiles are now Area-of-Effect, meaning they launch missiles at neighboring targets ;)
 Enemy Nanoswarm have some abilities of their own.
 Planet battle environment 3D models integrated
 Lightning strikes cause unit STUN in some battle environments, adding a new tactical layer
 Cloaked units can now be targeted by regular attacks but do only 1 unit of damage (unless cloak removed). 
 Initiate abilities fully unlocked in sector 3.
 Calculated damage to a unit's Health, Shields, Armor is now shown as 3 small colored # above the damage targeting UI
 Battle animations have been sped up drastically. All attacks now occur in <2 seconds, with the median being closer to 1.5. Moves are 1sec, and Destruction/Materialize animations for cards have also been updated to keep them <2 secs.

Bug Fixes

 Player colors are correct in battle
 Various UI styling patterns consolidated for better design language
 Battle controls greatly improved (common LMB/RMB actions are interchangeable, act as expected)
 Full screen menus can be exited with ESC key or RMB
 Auto end-turn for battle fixed
 Border artifacts in Main Menu on some resolutions fixed.
 Targeting reticle location adjusted for non-standard resolutions.
 Save/Load slot title is fixed to a maximum size that fits the UI
 Creating a New Profile with a name that exists displays a warning asking the player to pick a different name or delete the previous one.

Known Issues
These will be fixed in future patches

 Some Main Menu buttons have invisible no-click/hover zones. This is a hidden control that needs to be removed.
 Enemy commander avatars are shown on screen before they are mentioned in the storyline.

notes.title: Demo now Available for Steam Autumn Festival!
notes.content:
Demo and Tutorial
Our first public demo of Void Eclipse is now available to play on Steam! 

The Void Eclipse team has been hard at work since our Kickstarter to create a wholly new turn-based strategy game! 

An atmospheric take on the turn-based rpg genre, Void Eclipse blends elements of 4X, Roleplaying, and positional turn-based tactics. Player's take on the role of an Android with fragmented memories in the midst of an interstellar war.

notes.title: Void Eclipse Dev Blog #1
notes.content:
We had a lot of feedback from the Kickstarter and internal testing to incorporate into the game design. A lot of our focus these past months have been towards 2 items; improving our tutorial methods for teaching new players and improving the intuitiveness of the game controls.

Tutorial Improvements
We've moved our tutorial instructions into a simple itemized checklist that includes a video example on the side of the screen. This keeps the dialog of the characters from becoming a word salad of instructions. A picture is worth a thousand words, so a video is worth a million ;)

[previewyoutube=JeSa-do7BUM;full][/previewyoutube]

Battle Controls
The game controls have changed to allow users 2 primary moves (attack or move) to be based on mouse drag. The new controls use LeftClick+Drag to attack and RightClick+Drag to move. This is more intuitive  for players - and unique skills on the Skill wheel are now accessed with a quick RightClick.

[previewyoutube=rUsPrN9C1t4;full][/previewyoutube]

The core battle loop of attack, movement, and skill usage has been streamlined to create faster animations and improved understanding of the battlefield. Targeting reticles are shown when attacking that describe the damage type & amount that will occur if you proceed with that attack. This makes attacks that do Area-of-Effect or Piercing damage easier to understand.

Part of improving the game controls has been to condense strategic information into a quick glance. For that goal simply hovering over a card will show you all the important info in a glance (what skills does that unit have, it's status, etc.)

New Team Member
This month we were able to hire a local artist to help us with icon creation for all our unit abilities. Please welcome Olha to the team! We'll be sharing some of their work as we incorporate it into the game soon. In the meantime you can see some of their previous work on their artstation.
